rule: A stream goes live only when its one test on data it never saw has at least 50 signals, earns at least +0.05R per signal after real costs, has a profit factor of at least 1.1 and a drawdown smaller than half of its total result, and at least 70% of its signals reach their first target.
protocol: Engine 5 research (research/v5): gradient-boosted models on the site's own features; label = the first target (0.5R) before the stop; stops wide enough for the costs (crypto 15m 6 ATR, 1h 3 ATR, 4h 2 ATR; forex 4 / 2.5 / 2 ATR). Walk-forward: every fold is scored by a model trained only on candles from before it. Plan, score level, cost cap and higher-timeframe check are chosen on the validation years only (crypto 2023-01 to 2025-09, forex 2017-01 to 2022-02), then the choice is scored once on the unseen period (crypto 2025-10 to 2026-11; forex 2023-04 to 2026-10). Costs: crypto 0.30% per round trip plus funding for longs, forex the pair's spread plus slippage; entries at the price one or two minutes after the signal candle closed. Data: Binance spot candles of 94 coins; forex candles of 12 pairs and gold.
validation_rule: validation: win rate >= 73%, average >= +0.05R after costs, profit factor >= 1.15, at least 150 signals, every validation year (30+ signals) >= 68% wins with a positive average, and the next stricter score level holds up too (so the strictest level tried can never be chosen). Among the settings that pass and give at least one signal a day: the steadiest one (highest Sharpe ratio of the daily results), preferring the simplest plan (one target, no cost cap, no higher-timeframe check) when its Sharpe ratio is within 10% of the best
daily_signal_rule: daily signal (when the stream gave no signal for 24 hours, the best candidate from a lower score level gets one): used only when those 'standard' signals alone reach >= 70% wins and a positive average on the validation years with no year below -0.03R, and the whole stream still passes the validation rule; among the levels that pass, the one with the best average of the standard signals

fixed_before_the_test.note: Written BEFORE any holdout score of the engine 5 models was computed.
fixed_before_the_test.go_live_rule: streams.passed_test() on the one holdout test (>= 50 signals, >= +0.05R per signal after costs, profit factor >= 1.1, drawdown <= half of the total result) AND a holdout win rate >= 70%
